universe.name: Film Noir High-Contrast 2D/3D
universe.why: A gritty, shadowy heist movie aesthetic perfectly matches the theme of hoarding and stealing the ultimate treasure.
universe.pacing: Methodical, creeping tension that escalates into a frantic heist escape.
universe.signature_shot: A colossal, gleaming gold cube dwarfing a grim, high-contrast black-and-white 1950s tenement building in the fog.
universe.medium_break: During the vault scene, the penguin pauses its theft to wipe a smudge off the actual camera lens, leaving a greasy flipper print on the 'glass'.
universe.look_bible: 1950s Film Noir animation, high-contrast black and white with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, deep shadows, and cinematic smog. The ONLY color in the entire universe is the gleaming, metallic, hyper-reflective yellow-gold of the treasure. Textures are gritty, with celluloid film grain, harsh spotlights, and sleek art-deco architecture. 3D rendered in a stylized high-contrast noir aesthetic. Motion is smooth and cinematic like a classic tracking shot, with heavy atmospheric parallax.
universe.penguin_render: Stylized 3D noir penguin, stark black and white shading, but with its signature orange feet, beak tip, and three bent head feathers catching the harsh rim light.
universe.music: Upright bass walking line, brushed snare drums, and a muted, sneaky trumpet.

penguin.arc: Wants to quietly steal the world's gold, gets greedy, and ends up plunging into the abyss on a runaway handcar.

k01.prompt: Industrial noir foundry. A mountain of scattered gold bars moves up a massive conveyor belt under harsh spotlights. Deep shadows, cinematic smog, high-contrast black and white world where only the gold has color. 1950s Film Noir animation.
k01.penguin: Standing in the foreground shadow, wearing a tiny trenchcoat and fedora, quietly slipping a gold bar into its pocket.

k02.prompt: Inside a roaring crucible. The gold bars liquefy into a swirling, blindingly bright vortex of molten gold, illuminating the dark industrial walls with harsh yellow rim light. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k03.prompt: A colossal, gleaming gold cube sits cooling in a pitch-black city square. Steam rises off its razor-sharp edges into the cinematic smog. High-contrast noir architecture surrounds it in silhouette. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k04.prompt: Extreme close-up on the sheer, glowing surface of the newly formed gold cube. The hyper-reflective yellow-gold light fills the entire frame, blinding out the dark city. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k05.prompt: Street level wide shot. The giant gold cube sits imposing in a dark, foggy city intersection. The only color is the gleaming gold against the black and white city. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k06.prompt: Bird's-eye view looking straight down through the cinematic smog. Glowing white chalk lines of a baseball diamond surround the gold cube perfectly. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k07.prompt: Street level view, looking sharply UP from the pavement. The sheer vertical cliff of the gold cube dwarfs a grim, 7-story brick tenement building beside it. Deep shadows. 1950s Film Noir animation.
k07.penguin: Standing on the fire escape of the 7-story building, looking up at the cube while holding a tiny chisel.

k08.prompt: Extreme close-up on the cube's polished gold wall. Ghostly reflections of ancient Egyptian pharaohs and 19th-century miners move across the hyper-reflective yellow-gold surface. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k09.prompt: Inside the reflection itself. Swirling, abstract liquid gold entirely filling the frame. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k10.prompt: Blueprint / technical cutaway style: dark blue background with glowing cyan architectural wireframes, clean drafting marks, and rigid technical geometry. A glowing cyan wireframe 1-meter cube sits on a technical grid.

k11.prompt: Blueprint / technical cutaway style: dark blue background. A solid, heavy gold block has dropped into the glowing cyan wireframe bounds, shaking the grid lines with impact dust.

k12.prompt: Blueprint / technical cutaway style. Close to the grid floor. 12 blueprint-style 1950s sedans are hydraulically compressed into a cube and slammed down onto a technical scale next to the gold block.

k13.prompt: Cavernous, shadowy bank vault. Giant stacks of gold bars tower like skyscrapers. A silhouetted banker in a sharp suit sits atop the highest pile. Deep shadows, harsh spotlights, gold is the only color. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k14.prompt: A chaotic, glittering mountain of gold necklaces, tiaras, and rings spilling out of giant safety deposit boxes into the shadows. Hyper-reflective gold against black and white. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k15.prompt: Extreme close-up of a massive, glowing gold pendant draped over a black velvet bust. Deep background focus reveals the dark shadows of the vault. 1950s Film Noir animation.
k15.penguin: In the deep background blur, frantically shoveling loose jewelry into a canvas sack marked with a dollar sign.

k16.prompt: A gargantuan mechanical price ticker looming over the vault, its metal digits spinning wildly in a blur. Long, menacing shadows stretch across the room. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k17.prompt: The pitch-black inside of a spinning '0' on the mechanical ticker. Total darkness. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k18.prompt: Wide shot of the baseball diamond. A small, jagged tunnel entrance has been chipped away at the bottom corner of the giant gold cube. Black and white city, gold cube. 1950s Film Noir animation.

k19.prompt: Deep inside the dark, jagged tunnel. A runaway wooden handcar overflows with glowing gold bars, plunging off the end of a broken mine track into the abyss. 1950s Film Noir animation.
k19.penguin: Wearing a tiny burglar mask, frantically pumping the handcar handles, then flailing its stubby wings desperately trying to fly as the cart drops.

shots.motion: Camera flies forward along the conveyor belt and plunges directly into the roaring crucible.
shots.sfx: Heavy industrial machinery grinding, transitioning to a fiery roar.

shots.motion: Camera cranes straight up through the smoke as the molten metal instantly cools into the colossal cube in the city square.
shots.sfx: A massive, deep metallic thud and hissing steam.

shots.motion: Camera pushes aggressively into the sheer, glowing surface of the cube until gold fills the frame.
Camera rockets vertically upward to a bird's-eye view, revealing the glowing baseball diamond.
shots.sfx: A fast whoosh of displaced air.

shots.motion: Camera dives straight down to street level, tilting sharply up to frame the cube against the tenement building.
Camera pushes in close and orbits the gold wall, revealing the ghostly historical reflections moving across the surface.
Camera violently pushes directly into the gold reflection, turning the screen into abstract liquid gold.
Camera orbits 45 degrees as the solid gold block slams down into the wireframe, sending a visual shockwave through the grid.
Camera pushes in close to the grid floor as the 12 sedans are crushed and slam onto the scale.
shots.sfx: Hydraulic squeal and a heavy metallic crunch.

shots.motion: Camera whip-pans right from the neat towering gold bars to the chaotic mountain of spilled jewelry.
shots.sfx: A fast whoosh and the clinking of coins.

shots.motion: Camera pushes in slowly through the glittering mountain, finding the velvet bust and the thief in the background.
Camera tilts sharply up from the necklace to the gargantuan, spinning mechanical price ticker.
shots.sfx: Rapid mechanical clicking of vintage ticker digits.

shots.motion: Camera pushes straight into the spinning '0' of the ticker, plunging into total darkness.
Camera flies at warp speed into the tiny tunnel, tracking the runaway handcar as it plunges off the broken track.
shots.sfx: Squeaking wooden wheels, a comical slide-whistle drop, and a tiny thud.

cover.prompt: A colossal, gleaming gold cube dwarfing a grim 1950s noir tenement building. High-contrast black and white city with deep shadows, cinematic smog, and the cube as the only colored object, radiating hyper-reflective yellow-gold light. A tiny penguin in a trenchcoat stands on a fire escape looking at it.
